pairs.subject: hitl-approval
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:200 listPackets drops any v1 Weir pile whose packet id, run id or source fails to parse (e.g. a source missing from PACKET_SOURCES) from the Board's rail with no marker, no log and no count, so an unclassifiable pending decision never reaches the one review surface — the fall-through arm is silent removal rather than the loud, marked default the standard requires.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:200 An unparseable pile is skipped silently (line 202 does the same for an unknown mode); no defaulted-and-why marker, the operator never sees it.

app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:217 Gate state is read from the kernel store (head.state), not inferred; a decided packet refuses preview/decide. Writes go through money-guarded Server Actions (actions.ts).
app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:245 Commit records who (author: operator/surface/uid), binds the preview token (what was shown) and a fresh v1 digest so a stale preview is refused.
app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:249 Commit hands off to a durable apply outbox (pending/applied/stuck, redrive in actions.ts); a retried ticket gets the first result back.
app/(studio)/board/_port/real.ts:205 The rail is built from the system of record (kernel packets plus v1's unopened piles) with truncation stated; it has one hole, the silent drop at line 200.
app/(studio)/board/_board/Board.tsx:8 The Board is the review flow (a human rules on machine output); there is no machine-initiated capability use asking for consent here.
